game.name: The Powder Toy
game.desc: Powder Toy is a free physics simulation game that simulates air pressure and speed, heat, gravity, and an infinite number of interactions between different substances! The game provides you with various building materials, liquids, gases, and electronic components to create complex machines, weapons, bombs, realistic terrains, and much more. You can then detonate them and watch spectacular explosions, add complex wiring, play with little characters, or pilot your machine.
